chunks: Then anyone who turns away will be a transgressor.

key_terms.ذَٰلِكَ: that (referring to the clear truth or command)

ai.seo_question: Who are considered the transgressors (Fasiqun) in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the concept of *Tawalla* (loyalty) and *Tabarra* (disavowal), identifying those who consciously reject the clear guidance of the Ahl al-Bayt or divine command as *Fasiqun*. This classification underscores the ethical imperative of maintaining allegiance to the Imams after their authority has been established and recognized. The term highlights not merely a sin, but a state of moral corruption resulting from the rejection of known truth.
